values.note: Full hookup with 30/50 A and WiFi for 2 adults and 2 children: $35 for the two smaller pull-throughs (site 21 takes rigs to 30 ft, site 20 to 45 ft), $40 back-ins and pull-throughs, $45 premium and big-rig sites. Extra persons $5 a night. Weekly $200-265.

values.note: Book on CampLife (US$3.50 online fee) or by phone at 785-922-2267, or send the request form on the park's site. Cancel 10+ days out for a full refund less the online fee; 9 days or less forfeits one night. Check-in after 1 pm, check-out 11 am.

note: Private park just off I-70 exit 286 on the north edge of Chapman: grass sites with picnic tables, clubhouse with TV and games, playground, off-leash dog park. Popular cross-Kansas overnight stop. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $35-45 (operator's own rate table), full hookups to 50 A, showers, laundry, pull-throughs, private, not waterfront.
